response.original_title: [FAQ's Upgrade] How do i upgrade cabin on a Holland America Cruise?
response.overview: You can upgrade your cabin on a Holland America Cruise by paying  +1-866-829-1297 the exact fare difference ahead of time, bidding for a higher category through an optional program like Upgrade Advantage, or occasionally receiving a complimentary operational upgrade if a specific stateroom tier is overbooked. You can request a traditional paid upgrade by  +1-866-829-1297 calling customer service, bid for a room through the automated Holland America Cruise UpGrade program, or occasionally receive a free complimentary upgrade if lower-category rooms are overbooked. Yes,  +1-866-829-1297 you can upgrade your cabin on a Holland America Cruise by paying the fare difference directly before final payment, participating in the "Holland America Cruise Upgrade" blind-bidding program after final payment, or occasionally receiving a rare, complimentary operational upgrade.
